sealed_statement.family: For every k>=3, X_k is a source-valid P7-free state with one connected Q_ALL block, 2^(k-2) reachable canonical profiles, no globally missing color, and authorized future R2 activity in all four colors.
sealed_statement.P7: The authoritative arbitrary-k proof uses only the bipartition, universal seed vertex s1, the chain graph H, and the unique possible 7-role form r_t-z-r_j-l_i-s4-l_h-r_c, whose chordlessness inequalities give h<j<=i<c<=h.
sealed_statement.source: Axioms (i)-(vi) hold at the root and remain unchanged under the exponential forcing family F subseteq {l_2,...,l_{k-1}} fixed to color 1.
sealed_statement.multiplicity: Different F yield pairwise distinct profiles by the surviving L-to-R degree set, giving 2^(k-2) profiles inside one connected Q_ALL block after A/B/C reductions.
sealed_statement.four_color: L palettes contain 1,2,3 and R palettes contain 2,3,4; hence every color in [4] is live somewhere and colors 1,2,3,4 each occur in authorized R2 queries.
sealed_statement.carrier: The nonfixed core is always an induced subgraph of the original chain graph H. With current exact lists contained in fixed total palette [4], polynomial List Coloring on permutation graphs with bounded total colors applies. ACTIVE/FIXED/DELETED plus 4-bit lists, fixed colors and receipt pointers gives a polynomial exact query/update/reconstruction carrier.
sealed_statement.constructive: A coloring witness is recovered by self-reduction with at most four decision trials per active vertex.
sealed_statement.interpretation: X_k falsifies the hypothesis that exponential connected profiles plus genuine four-color activity and absence of a global missing color imply hard future representation.

source_backend.claim_used: Polynomial-time List Coloring on permutation graphs for bounded total number of colors.
source_backend.application: X_k uses fixed palette [4] and every active core is an induced chain/permutation graph.

explicit_nonclaims: No polynomial carrier theorem for arbitrary connected Q_ALL.
